justification: Adds a production table of confirmed per-council flood information and shows it with not-known flood answers. Not Critical: only adds sourced pointers to user-facing text; never changes a yes/no. Not Minor: new production table and served wording.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Fails if the sentence uses anything but held facts, or the answer stops carrying council info.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Each stored fact was re-fetched from its cited council page on 2026-10-29 and kept only if the page contains it (verified_2026-10-29.json).
falsifiable_check.observed_red: New tests cover behaviour absent before (no council info existed).

pre_impl.existing_data: No per-council flood information table existed; flood-lgas.ts held unsourced marketing copy (24 of 32 counts wrong).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Research helpers reported more facts than pages confirm (viewer 2/10, certificate 8/19, FPL 0 after paraphrases dropped).
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New table (migration 118, approved) and loader; producer wrapper.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Lookup failure returns no council info; the flood answer is unchanged.

functions.name: council_info_sentence
functions.what: Plain sentence of where to get the council's flood information.
functions.input: the council_flood_context row as a dict
functions.output: one sentence, or None when nothing is held
functions.if_none: A None input returns None, so no sentence.

functions.name: _council_info
functions.what: Reads the confirmed facts for a council.
functions.output: dict of confirmed facts or None
functions.if_none: No row or lookup failure returns None.

break_it.scenario: Research gave a paraphrased flood planning level
break_it.what_happens: It is not stored, so it is never shown as the council's wording
break_it.how: loader drops search-summary and elided quotes

break_it.scenario: The council_flood_context lookup fails at query time
break_it.what_happens: No council sentence; the flood answer is unchanged
break_it.how: try/except returns None and rolls back

break_it.scenario: Council has only a flood-study listing
break_it.what_happens: Sentence points to the flood study listing
